## Pumps
https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/category/pumps

### Kurlar Stainless Steel Submersible Pumps
Model: KP
Genuine Kurlar KP stainless steel submersible pumps. Their corrosion-resistant AISI 304 and AISI 316 construction delivers long service life and reliable performance for demanding agricultural irrigation, industrial water supply, and groundwater dewatering applications.
Specs: High Efficiency,Stainless Steel,Deep Well
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/pump-submersible

### Cast Stainless Submersible Pumps
Model: KSX
Genuine Kurlar KSX cast stainless steel submersible pumps (6"-8"-10"). All wetted parts — diffusers, impellers, and suction/discharge chambers — are cast in AISI 304 stainless steel for outstanding corrosion resistance, high efficiency, and long service life. Suitable for both horizontal and vertical installation; full AISI 316L construction available on request.
Specs: Cast Stainless Steel,Corrosion Resistant,6"-10"
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/pump-cast-stainless

### Rovatti Borehole Pumps
Model: 8E - 8ER - 10E - 10ER
Italian-built borehole pumps from Rovatti Pompe, in cast iron and cast steel with AISI 316 stainless available, in the 8" and 10" sizes most Egyptian wells are cased for. Each size comes in two hydraulics: radial for high head — the 8" reaches 675 m — and mixed-flow for high volume, where the 10" carries up to 420 m³/h. The check valve is built into the delivery bowl.
Specs: Cast Iron & Cast Steel,8" to 10",Made in Italy
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/pump-rovatti

### Panelli Submersible Pumps
Model: 140-270 SX
Italian-built submersible pumps from Panelli, in cast iron and cast steel as well as micro-cast AISI 304 stainless, with 8" and 10" the sizes most Egyptian wells are cased for. The 8" 180 SX covers 78 to 140 m³/h at 10 to 150 HP, and the 10" 230 SX covers 200 to 280 m³/h at 25 to 340 HP. Semiaxial impellers suit mid-to-high flows at moderate head, which is the shape of most irrigation and water-network duty. Tell us the well's yield and depth and our engineers will size the pump for it.
Specs: Cast Iron & Cast Steel,8" & 10",Made in Italy
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/pump-panelli-sx

### Tormac Stainless Steel Submersible Pumps
Model: TS - TN
Tormac TS series borehole submersible pumps in fully stainless steel construction — AISI 304 as version TS, AISI 316 as version TN — for 4", 6", 8" and 10" wells. Discharge from 0.4 to 280 m³/h and total head to 870 m at 2900 rpm, with NEMA-standard spline coupling and performance certified to ISO 9906:2012 Grade 3B. Manufactured in ISO 9001 facilities.
Specs: AISI 304 / 316,4" – 10",0.4–280 m³/h
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/pump-tormac-ts

https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/category/surface-pumps

### Rovatti Surface Pumps
Italian-built surface pumps from Rovatti Pompe, carried as a complete range: single-stage and multistage centrifugal electric pumps in horizontal and vertical execution, bare-shaft surface pumps for coupling to a motor or engine, and waste water electric submersible pumps with single-channel, double-channel and vortex impellers. Suited to irrigation, water supply and pressure boosting, industrial service water and drainage.
Specs: Surface & Waste Water,Single & Multistage,Made in Italy
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/pump-rovatti-surface

### Tormac Surface Pumps
Tormac surface pumps, carried across the range: TCCH close coupled units, TEH and TEC horizontal end-suction centrifugals, THSC horizontal split case pumps for high flows, and TV vertical multistage pumps for high head from a small footprint — with matched induction motors supplied alongside. Used for irrigation, water supply and pressure boosting, and industrial and building services, in 50 Hz.
Specs: Close Coupled to Split Case,50 Hz,Motors Included
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/pump-tormac-surface

## Motors
https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/category/motors

### Franklin Electric Submersible Motors
Franklin Electric submersible motors in 8" and 10". The 8" runs 40 to 200 HP at 50 Hz, with a Hi-Temp 75 build rated to 75°C ambient for hot or slow-flowing wells, tripping before an overheat burns the winding. The 10" is rewindable at 175 to 250 HP on 380-415 V. Both use the Sand Fighter seal system, and both are available in full 316 stainless or 904 L.
Specs: 8" & 10",40-250 HP,Class F
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/motor-franklin

### Panelli Submersible Motors
Water-filled rewindable submersible motors from Panelli of Italy, in 8" and 10" to match the SX pump ends, with the wider range running from 0.37 kW up to 300 kW. Cast iron and stainless steel bodies are both available to suit the water the motor will sit in.
Specs: Rewindable,8" & 10",Made in Italy
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/motor-panelli

### Kurlar Submersible Motors
Model: KM
Genuine Kurlar submersible motors (6"-8"-10"), rewindable and rated for continuous operation up to 60°C. High-temperature PBN winding wire, water-cooled construction, and a stainless steel shaft deliver a longer service life and lower operating cost than standard motors, manufactured in ISO 9001 certified facilities.
Specs: HI-TEMP 60°C,IP68,Water-Cooled
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/motor-hitemp

### Tormac ECO Series Submersible Motors
Model: D4 - D10
Tormac ECO series borehole submersible motors — water-cooled and rewindable in the field. Stainless steel stator shell, housings and motor base resist corrosion; the pressure-equalising diaphragm and shaft seal keep sand and well water out of the winding. Available 4", 6", 8" and 10", 380/415 V three phase, to NEMA mounting standards and ISO 9001.
Specs: Rewindable,IP68,NEMA Standard
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/motor-tormac-eco

## Electrical Component
https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/category/electrical

### NOVO Inverter
An advanced, high-efficiency solar-driven pump controller with Dynamic MPPT technology, delivering stable performance, intelligent power management, and long-life reliability for agricultural, industrial, and off-grid water pumping applications. Supports solar-only or hybrid solar + grid operation with automatic switching.
Specs: Dynamic MPPT,Solar + Grid Hybrid,0.37-400 kW
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/elec-inverter

### Electrical Control Panels
Pump and motor control panels built up in El Waha's own workshop, in three starting types: inverter (VFD) for variable-speed control, soft starter for a gradual ramp up to full speed, and star-delta for stepped starting on larger motors. Each panel is specified against the motor it will run, and brings the starting current down so the well starts without the shock that shortens motor and pump life. Housed in a floor-standing steel enclosure with MCCB incoming protection, copper busbars, DIN-rail control gear, and door-mounted indication.
Specs: Built In-House,Inverter · Soft Start · Star-Delta,Motor Protection
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/elec-control-panel

## Pipes
https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/category/pipes

### Astral Pipes
Model: Bore-Well
Genuine Astral Bore-Well lead-free column pipes for submersible pumps. Manufactured with square-thread couplers, EPDM 'O' Ring seals, and a double stainless steel stud pin locking system, they are 100% free of lead and heavy metals, UV-stabilised, and rigorously tested for leak-proof, long-lasting performance in deep well and borehole installations.
Specs: Lead-Free uPVC,EPDM Sealed,1"-6"
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/pipe-upvc-column

## Spare Parts
https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/category/spare-parts

### ALKA Thrust Bearings
Model: AP+ Series
Genuine Alka AP+ Series silicon carbide (SiC) ceramic thrust bearings, engineered for challenging deep-well applications where sand, ferrous debris, or high thrust loads exceed the capacity of conventional bearings. Retaining full strength at temperatures up to 1100°C and validated through in-house and field testing, they deliver outstanding wear resistance and reliability where standard stainless steel or carbon bearings fail.
Specs: Silicon Carbide,1100°C Rated,Sand Resistant
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/thrust-bearing-heavy

### Voltson Wires
Model: EXCELGRIP
Genuine Voltson EXCELGRIP poly-wrapped winding wire for rewinding submersible pump motors. Built on EC grade ETP copper of 99.95% minimum purity and wrapped in bi-axially oriented polypropylene, it holds its insulation up to 120°C and is heavily annealed so it lays into stator slots without cracking. Every coil is high-voltage tested at 3.5 kV rms and the range is tested to IS 8783, in sizes from 0.40 to 2.40 mm² on 500 m and 1000 m coils.
Specs: ETP Copper 99.95%,120°C Rated,IS 8783
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/winding-wire-voltson

## Cables
https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/category/cables

### Aristoncavi Cable
Model: H07RN8-F
Genuine Aristoncavi SUBMERSIBLE 07 (H07RN8-F) rubber cable to EN 50525-2-21, IEMMEQU <HAR> approved. A class 5 bare copper conductor with EPR insulation and a water-resistant EM2 rubber sheath, rated 450/750 V and permanently submersible to 100 m in fresh or salt water — the power feed between the panel and a submersible motor down the borehole.
Specs: H07RN8-F,EPR / Rubber,100 m Immersion
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/cable-submersible

### Untel Cable
Model: H07VVH6-F
Genuine Üntel H07VVH6-F PVC flat power and control cable, rated 450/750V, used for power and control wiring inside pump control panels, starter cabinets, and deep well pump stations. IPX8 tested by TÜV for permanent submersion up to 10 bar (100 m), UV resistant, and flame retardant.
Specs: IPX8 Submersible,450/750V,3x10-3x120 mm²
URL: https://elwahapumps.com/en/products/cable-flat-untel
